name: Default
shortDescription: All-in-one OpenTelemetry backend: an OTel Collector, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki and Pyroscope behind a preconfigured Grafana, in a single container.

alerts.message: Sign in to Grafana as admin with the generated GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD value from the environment variables. The OTLP/HTTP endpoint at https://<domain>/v1 has no authentication: anyone who knows the domain can send telemetry, so do not share it with untrusted clients.
Upstream builds this image for development, demo and testing environments rather than production monitoring.
